name: San Cataldo (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Cataldo (a cross and wheat on green) within white mantling.
history: Municipal flag of San Cataldo, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Cataldo arms — cross and wheat on green, crowned, within white mantling
